description: Source code implementing parsing functions for transport security state configuration, including JSON and certificate file parsing, with classes and functions related to pinsets, certificates, and transport security entries.

methods.name: IsImportantWordInCertificateName
methods.description: Checks if a given word is considered important in a certificate name.

methods.name: FilterName
methods.description: Removes all characters not matching [A-Za-z0-9_] from the input name and converts to lowercase.

methods.name: MatchCertificateName
methods.description: Determines if a certificate name reasonably matches a pin name based on various heuristics.

methods.name: IsValidName
methods.description: Validates if a candidate name starts with an uppercase letter and contains only alphanumeric characters or underscores.

methods.name: ParseCertificatesFile
methods.description: Parses a certificate file input, extracting pinsets and timestamp, validating certificate data.

methods.name: ParseJSON
methods.description: Parses HSTS and pinning JSON data, populates transport security entries and pinsets, with validation.
